metadata.purpose: Machine-readable blocker list for full headscale-go replacement parity claims.

open_items.exit_criteria: Broaden production server-process Postgres mutation/restart coverage beyond the current selected stock-client matrix, focused API-key/preauth-key plus gateway user-rename/node-owner restart smokes, the paired stock-client policy/config map-churn restart row, and the paired stock-client user/node lifecycle restart row, especially remaining routes, auth/API sessions, additional config churn, registration, and map-stream churn cases.
Audit and pin remaining Tailscale ACL/grants/nodeAttrs/routes/SSH compatibility fixtures in the differential harness.

Broaden production backfill/restart edges beyond covered restart-persistence, prefix-family hydration, the PostgreSQL IPv4-to-dual-stack route-preservation restart row, and the PostgreSQL IPv4-to-dual-stack MagicDNS A/AAAA restart row; remaining closure candidates are SSH/policy multi-address behavior after backfill/restart.
Add remaining lower-priority CLI output/error snapshots and process-level config/output tests while keeping Octra-only commands outside parity claims.

Continue broadening live resolver client behavior beyond current netmap/DNSConfig, stock-client MagicDNS, live split-resolver A/AAAA, and extra-record reload coverage. The paired search-domain and multi-resolver/failure-fallback live rows are wired with deterministic expectation-builder coverage, but still need passing live runs before this row can close.
